name: Pappas Foods LLC
old_description: At Lassonde Pappas we deliver award-winning quality, service and reliability. Customer Service is our dedication. We consistently work to ensure customer satisfaction through strategic partnerships, continuous communication and the building of strong long-term relationships.
about:
Pappas Foods LLC, operating as Lassonde Pappas, is headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas. The company manufactures a range of shelf-stable beverages and food products for distribution across multiple channels of trade.

Its product portfolio includes organic, natural, and conventional shelf-stable juices, ready-to-drink teas, enhanced waters, isotonics, and cranberry sauces. Production takes place in strategically located, state-of-the-art multi-process facilities capable of multi-serve, single-serve, and multi-pack formats. An in-house R&D team supports collaborative innovation and product development, while dedicated food safety, regulatory affairs, and quality assurance groups monitor compliance with customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

The company serves customers through many classes of trade nationwide, supplying retail, foodservice, and other distribution channels. Its business model emphasizes strategic partnerships and continuous communication to build long-term relationships.

Lassonde Pappas differentiates itself through award-winning quality, a customer-service-first philosophy, and a commitment to employee development. The firm states that its manufacturing expertise and collaborative R&D approach enable it to deliver exceptional value and meet customers' strategic initiatives.
